limitations: 177 programs total, 124 used for training: every reported metric is preliminary and generalization to unseen TAC programs is not established.

The corpus is generator-derived: 15 of the 17 generation categories carry exactly one winning label, and every category present in the test split also appears in the training split. A high test score therefore shows that the forest learned the generator's opportunity patterns - it is not evidence that the model generalizes to arbitrary handwritten TAC.

Held-out category coverage is incomplete: 4 of the 17 generation categories (algebraic_simplification, common_subexpression, dead_code_elimination, no_opportunity) contribute zero test samples, so those generation patterns are never evaluated directly. All five target labels still appear in the test split with support between 2 and 8, but per-category behaviour on those four is unmeasured.

num_dead_stmts is the strongest predictor (SHAP rank 1). It is a static liveness count computed from the instruction stream, not the output of running the dead-code pass, but it does directly measure the opportunity that dead_code_elimination exploits.
Classes are imbalanced (59 vs 18 in the largest/smallest class), so macro-F1 is the primary metric rather than accuracy.
strength_reduction has no winning examples, so it is absent from the target vocabulary and the model can never predict it.
strength_reduction is currently a documented no-op in the engine, which is why it never wins a label.

The 10 no_opportunity programs all share the tie-break label chosen when every pass scores zero, so part of the learned mapping reproduces the deterministic tie rule rather than an optimization insight.
Ground-truth labels are defined by optimizer.measure's useful_improvement (statement reduction + operation reduction), so 'correct' means 'agrees with that definition', not 'provably optimal'.
Only 26 held-out test samples exist, so the confusion matrix is sparse and per-class recall on the test split is unstable (support ranges from 2 to 8).
Validation metrics are reported for the configuration selected on that same split, so they are mildly optimistic; the test split is untouched.

tuning.strategy: fixed grid, selected by validation macro-F1
